name: Capitulation triple-confluence: extreme-fear + funding flush + vol spike (NOT fear-alone)
rationale: Thesis: Fear&Greed-alone contrarian is EXHAUSTED — it fires too often and on shallow dips. The edge is the RARE confluence where three independent stress axes agree at once: crowd sentiment (fear_greed) at an extreme low, leveraged-positioning capitulation (funding_rate flushed to a low/negative level = perp longs washed out, NOT crowded long), AND a realized-volatility spike marking forced selling. The Extremity Premium result (sentiment extremity carries information beyond realized vol) means fear_greed and vol_realized are NOT redundant, so requiring BOTH plus a positioning flush isolates genuine capitulation bottoms from ordinary dips. RSI oversold is an optional fourth confirm. This is a positioning+sentiment+vol COMPOSITE at the swing horizon, not a single tired level. Disconfirmer(s): must beat (a) fear_greed-extreme ALONE — if lone-fear matches or beats net Sharpe the confluence adds nothing and we have re-derived the exhausted F&G-alone signal; and (b) funding-low ALONE — to rule out that this is just funding-carry capitulation. The composite must beat BOTH single-feature ablations after fees. Long-only crypto spot.
catalyst: extreme-fear sentiment + perp-funding flush + realized-vol climax aligning on the same day
